company_description: Legrand SA, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, distributes, and sells electrical and digital building infrastructures in Europe, North and Central America, and internationally. The company offers energy distribution, protection, and management solutions, such as electric vehicle charging, residential and small commercial panels, switchboards and power cabinets, and UPS devices; and wiring devices, connected home and building control solutions, and guestroom solutions, as well as flush-mounted, junction, DCL, and floor boxes. It also provides security, communication, and network solutions, including access security, digital home networks, emergency lighting, fire alarms, IT networks, intercom and door entry, and nurse call systems; conduits and cable management solutions comprising trunking, mini-trunking, skirting trunking, ducts, tubes, floor boxes, columns and feeders, and workstation solutions; industrial products, which comprises industrial enclosures and connections, transformers and power supply, marking accessories and cable ties, motor control and protection, fuse protection, and industrial plugs and sockets, as well as control, button, and signaling products; an

description.long_fr: Legrand est un leader mondial des infrastructures électriques et numériques du bâtiment. Le groupe développe interrupteurs, prises, tableaux électriques, gestion câbles, datacenters (UPS), éclairage assisté et solutions de bornes de recharge VE. Présent dans ~90 pays. Chiffre d'affaires 2024 : ~8.6 Mds €.
description.long_en: Legrand is a global leader in electrical and digital building infrastructure. The group develops switches, sockets, electrical panels, cable management, datacentre solutions (UPS), assisted lighting and EV charging stations. Present in ~90 countries. 2024 revenue: ~€8.6 bn.
description.long_de: Legrand ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von elektrischen und digitalen Infrastrukturen für Gebäude. Der Konzern entwickelt Schalter, Steckdosen, Stromverteilungen, Kabelmanagement, Rechenzentren (USV), unterstützende Beleuchtung und Lösungen für Elektrofahrzeug‑Ladestationen. Präsenz in rund 90 Ländern. Konzernumsatz 2024: rund 8,6 Mrd. €.
